roles.shared: 同一parameter_id同时出现在effectiveness与price绑定中；界面只显示一次，修改后两个模型都重算
roles.effectiveness_only: 默认显示并允许按DataMaster设置编辑
roles.price_only: 默认隐藏，用户展开价格相关属性后显示

effectiveness_source: Workbook + optional matching state JSON + original reconstruction code
price_source: raw training table retrained into deployable pure-JSON ensemble
